prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for a 2D fairy-tale tactical idle RPG, RogueTales. Camera: elevated three-quarter overhead, like a polished hand-painted mobile RPG battle arena; the ground occupies 85 percent of the composition, it is a FLAT WALKABLE GROUND PLANE, no vertical chessboard pattern. Clear gently lit central staging area with generous negative space on BOTH left and right halves where separately rendered character squads will stand. Soft painterly shapes, refined cel shading, restrained low contrast details, desaturated slate grey, muted blue, dark sage greenery and a little warm amber. Mystical storybook atmosphere, sophisticated 2D game environment art, not pixel art, no photorealism or 3D. Keep foreground flat, unobstructed and visually quiet. No characters, no monsters, no people, no weapons, no circles under characters, no interface, no text, no lettering, no counters, no panels, no logos, no borders or watermark. Output only the actual background illustration.
usage: Shared battle background for portrait mobile and landscape PC. The UI remains native Godot controls. Original PNG preserved.
